en: Color photo postcard showing a green roundabout or small square in a residential neighborhood with 4–5 story socialist-era apartment blocks, detached houses, trees, pedestrians, and a bust statue on a pedestal. Reverse side has handwritten Romanian text, an orange 40 Bani stamp inscribed "R.P. ROMINA," and postmarks from Suceava and București dated 19.VIII.1967. Printed line at bottom reads "SUCEAVA," with publisher note "Arta Grafică" and price.
